en.name: Green beans
en.summary: Green beans are immature bean pods eaten whole, and they lose their snap faster than they lose their looks. Refrigerated at 4 °C (40 °F) or below they keep 3–5 days from the day of purchase, and blanched and frozen they hold good quality for about 8 months.
en.pantry: Green beans should not be kept at room temperature. The pods are thin and lose water quickly, so in a warm kitchen they go flexible and leathery within a day and develop rusty brown spots soon after. There is no room-temperature figure for them here and none should be assumed. Refrigerate them as soon as you get home, unwashed.
en.fridge: Store green beans unwashed in a perforated bag in the crisper at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, where they keep 3–5 days from purchase. They need a little humidity but not wet: a bag with holes or a box lined with kitchen paper suits them better than a sealed container, where condensation turns the pods slimy. Do not trim the ends until you cook them, since every cut is a place to lose water and pick up bacteria.
en.freezer: Green beans freeze well, but they must be blanched — raw-frozen beans turn dull, tough and off-flavoured as their enzymes keep working. Top and tail, boil for 3 minutes, plunge into iced water, drain thoroughly, then freeze spread on a tray before bagging so they stay loose. At −18 °C (0 °F) they are safe indefinitely and keep good quality for about 8 months.
en.thawing: Cook green beans from frozen. Drop them into boiling water, a steamer or a hot pan without thawing, allowing an extra minute or two. Thawed beans are limp and watery and will not crisp up again.
spoilage: Pods that bend instead of snapping cleanly in half
Brown or rust-coloured spots spreading along the pod
Slimy, wet or darkened patches, especially where beans touched
A sour smell, or visible mould at the stem end
tips: Choose beans that snap audibly when you bend one — that is the freshness test.
Store unwashed and untrimmed; prepare them only when you are ready to cook.
Freeze on a tray first so you can pour out exactly the handful you need.
Cook them properly — green beans should never be eaten raw or barely cooked.

faq.q: How long do green beans last in the fridge?
faq.a: 3–5 days from the day of purchase at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, unwashed in a perforated bag in the crisper.
Yes, after blanching for 3 minutes and chilling in iced water. Packed airtight at −18 °C (0 °F) they keep good quality for about 8 months.

faq.q: Can you eat green beans raw?
faq.a: No. Raw and undercooked green beans contain lectins that cause stomach upset, so cook them through until they are tender rather than squeaky.

faq.q: What are the brown spots on my green beans?
faq.a: They are usually rust or bruising from handling and cold damage. A few small spots can be trimmed away; widespread brown patches with softness mean the beans should go.

zh.name: 四季豆
zh.summary: 四季豆是連莢食用的未熟豆莢，它失去脆度的速度比外觀變差還快。冷藏在 4°C 以下，從購買當天算起可放 3～5 天；汆燙後冷凍則能維持約 8 個月的良好品質。
zh.pantry: 四季豆不適合放室溫。豆莢很薄，失水非常快，在溫暖的廚房裡一天就會變得軟軟可彎，接著長出鏽褐色斑點。這裡不提供常溫保存的天數，也請不要自行推估。買回家請不清洗直接冷藏。
zh.fridge: 不清洗，裝進打洞袋放在 4°C 以下的蔬果保鮮室，從購買日起可放 3～5 天。它需要一點濕度但不能濕：打洞袋或鋪廚房紙巾的保鮮盒，都比完全密封的容器好，密封容器裡凝結的水會讓豆莢變黏。另外，要煮之前再摘蒂去筋，因為每一個切口都會流失水分、也是細菌的入口。
zh.freezer: 四季豆很適合冷凍，但一定要先汆燙——生凍的豆莢酵素持續作用，顏色會變暗、口感變柴、還會產生怪味。摘掉頭尾，滾水煮 3 分鐘，撈起泡冰水，徹底瀝乾後先攤在托盤上凍硬再裝袋，可以保持顆粒分明。放 −18°C 安全上可無限期保存，品質可維持約 8 個月。
zh.thawing: 四季豆請不解凍直接煮。冷凍狀態下丟進滾水、蒸鍋或熱鍋，加熱時間多抓一兩分鐘。解凍後的豆莢軟爛出水，再也脆不回來。
spoilage: 折彎時只是彎曲，不會清脆地折斷
豆莢上出現褐色或鏽色斑點並且擴散
有黏滑、濕爛或發黑的區塊，尤其是豆莢互相接觸的地方
有酸味，或蒂頭處看得到黴
tips: 挑折一下會發出清脆聲響的，那就是新鮮度測試。
保存時不洗、不摘頭尾，要煮之前再處理。
先攤在托盤上凍硬再裝袋，之後要用多少倒多少。
一定要煮熟；四季豆絕對不能生吃或半生食用。

faq.q: 四季豆放冰箱可以放多久？
faq.a: 4°C 以下冷藏，不清洗、裝打洞袋放蔬果室，從購買當天算起 3～5 天。
可以，先汆燙 3 分鐘並冰鎮瀝乾。密封後放 −18°C 冷凍，品質可維持約 8 個月。
不可以。生的或沒煮透的四季豆含有凝集素，會引起腸胃不適，一定要煮到完全軟熟，不要留生脆感。

faq.q: 四季豆上的褐斑是什麼？
faq.a: 多半是碰撞或低溫傷害造成的鏽斑。少數小斑點削掉即可；如果褐斑大片又伴隨變軟，就該丟掉。
